items.text: The dalton is 1/12 of the mass of an unbound neutral carbon-12 atom at rest in its ground state, physicists' bodies coming to it in 1960 and chemists' in 1961 in place of two oxygen scales and the 2019 SI having it still: each atom's mass a number of twelfths of one carbon atom, a unit a body chooses.
